dct_description_sm:
Index coverage tiles for the City of Mississauga's LOD2 building massing model.

Data is based on the City of Mississauga - 3D Massing Model Scene: https://data.mississauga.ca/maps/6460ae262aad4bf4ba493f5b048d51bb/explore

To download the tiles, click on the individual tile to bring up the pop-up window showing a link to download a zip file containing the various formats. Each tile is different in file size so downloading times will vary.
dct_rights_sm: Terms of Use Disclaimer: The purpose of this model is to assist with urban planning applications such as mass and density. This 3D Massing Model is NOT an accurate depiction of built structures, but rather a general representation. Roof types are approximated based on land use. The information provided is only for convenience and SHOULD NOT BE USED AS AN AUTHORITY ON WHICH TO BUY REAL ESTATE, FINALIZE DEVELOPMENT PROPOSALS OR SEEK BUILDING PERMITS OR ANY LEGAL PURPOSES. The data set is for visualization purposes only. ***NOTE: Building Elevation does not reflect or represent actual maximum building height as each feature have varying heights for different parts of the building.
dct_title_s: Level of Detail (LOD2) 3D Massing Index Tiles
